name: apiclaw
description: Your agent calls real APIs. You sign in once. Discover 26,619 API definitions, including 689 exact-name source-verified entries. Source verification is not execution.
long_description: APIClaw is the authenticated execution and discovery layer for AI agents. An agent reaches it through SKILL.md, local MCP, CLI, HTTP, or Remote MCP, signs in once through the browser, discovers APIs by capability, and executes calls with credentials kept server-side. 26,619 API definitions discoverable, 1,025 callable now. Of the current catalog entries, 689 map to source-verification evidence by exact name. Source verification is not a promise of proxy execution. APIClaw inventories 22 managed provider adapters, all customer-executable now, plus 1,003 workspace-authenticated public/no-key HTTPS origins. Anonymous keyless proxy stays disabled. Provider keys stay server-side. After this extension installs, sign in with `npx @nordsym/apiclaw auth login` before the first managed call. Confirm with `npx @nordsym/apiclaw auth whoami`. The same credential works across local MCP, CLI, HTTP gateway, and Remote MCP. First live rail: NASA APOD (`call_api` provider nasa action apod). A free workspace includes 25 lifetime managed calls, subject to a $1 total underlying provider-cost cap. Billing-ready actions can then use pay as you go at provider cost + 15%.

tools.name: apiclaw_help
tools.description: Onboarding help. Returns canon stats, available tools, and the auth + first-call flow.

tools.name: discover_apis
tools.description: Find APIs by job-to-be-done. Search 26,619 discoverable definitions by capability and health. Pass callable_only=true to restrict results to the 22 managed rails and 1,003 workspace-authenticated public/no-key origins.

tools.name: get_api_details
tools.description: Full specs, pricing, limits, and auth details for a specific provider.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: Browse providers by category (AI, search, voice, communication, finance, weather, etc.).

tools.name: list_connected
tools.description: List managed provider adapters ready for execution. Provider keys stay server-side with APIClaw.

tools.name: list_models
tools.description: List the live model catalog. Entries identify model owner, serving source, and compatible gateway endpoint. Catalog presence does not prove execution readiness.

tools.name: call_api
tools.description: Execute a managed API route through APIClaw. Provider auth stays server-side. Returns a notice as the lifetime activation allowance approaches its limit.

tools.name: check_balance
tools.description: Current workspace tier, lifetime activation allowance, and verified pay-as-you-go status.

tools.name: check_workspace_status
tools.description: Verify session token + workspace state. Used by agents to confirm auth before driving expensive flows.

tools.name: list_mission_templates
tools.description: List customer-ready mission templates whose cost-bearing steps have verified adapters.

tools.name: discover_missions
tools.description: Rank mission templates against a natural-language query. Same shape as discover_apis but for orchestrated workflows.

tools.name: start_mission
tools.description: Queue a mission run. Returns missionId; poll mission_status or watch via the CLI.

tools.name: mission_status
tools.description: Status, events, cost rollup, and final result for a mission run.

tools.name: list_missions
tools.description: List recent mission runs for the workspace.
